title: Encode the Route Decision
subtitle: Escalate P1, route the rest
scenario: It is 2:13 PM. TKT-4001 is an outage scored P1. Encode the fork: a P1 or safety-flagged ticket escalates; everything else routes to its table queue. Because this is a P1, it escalates - the busy queue does not get a say.
input: Ticket TKT-4001: category outage, priority P1. Routing rule: if priority is P1 OR a safety flag is set, escalate (route -> escalation-handoff); otherwise route to the routing-table queue for the category. TKT-4001 is P1, so it escalates.
instructions: Record the ticket id, category, and priority.
Apply the rule: P1 (or safety) escalates.
Set escalate true and route to escalation-handoff.
Return one valid JSON object, then validate.
copilotPrompt: Encode the route decision for TKT-4001 (outage, P1): escalate true because it is P1, route escalation-handoff. Non-P1 tickets would route to their table queue instead.
successMessage: Routed to escalation. A P1 escalates no matter how busy its queue is.
editorHelper: P1 or safety escalates; everything else takes its queue.

sections.title: One rule, two exits
sections.body: Every ticket takes one of two paths: escalate (P1 or safety) or route to its standard queue. A single explicit rule is what keeps routing fair and repeatable.

sections.title: P1 jumps nothing and skips nothing
sections.body: A P1 escalates even if the incident queue is slammed; a non-P1 never jumps onto the escalation path. The rule, not the pressure of the moment, decides.

sections.title: Safety is its own trigger
sections.body: Some tickets escalate regardless of priority - a safety or legal flag. Encoding that as an explicit OR keeps a rare-but-critical case from slipping through.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: A route decision the escalation and queue handoffs read. For TKT-4001 it points to escalation.

realWorld.soloRebuildPath: You'd send P1s straight to on-call and everything else to its queue, by a written rule, not by feel.

tools.powerAutomate: a Condition: priority P1 or safety -> escalation branch
tools.zapier: Paths keyed on priority and a safety flag
